Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 9933 - 1981 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RETRACTOR, BRAIN, MALLEABLE 



( Reaffirmed 1997) 



1- Scope — Material, dimensional and other requirements for six sizes of malleable brain retractors 
used in neurosurgery. 

2. Material — Cold rolled stainless steel sheet 0'90 mm thick, conforming to Designation 04Cr18Ni10 
or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS : 6911-1972 'Specification for stainless steel plate, sheet and strip'. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

AM dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 RETRACTOR, BRAIN, MALLEABLE 

3.1 Tolerance on various dimensions shall be permitted as given below: 

a) ± 0'1 mm on thickness, 

b) ± 10 mm on width up to 15 mm, 

c) ± 2'5 mm on width greater than 15 mm and up to 30 mm, and 

d) ± 5'0 mm on length. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The retractor shall be of one piece and shall be free from burrs, pits, cracks and other surface 
defects. 

4.2 All the edges of the retractor shall be evenly rounded and shall be nowhere sharp. 

4.3 The retractor shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance — Scrap the retractor with soap and warm water, rinse in hot water and 

then dip in 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the retractor. Immerse in copper sulphate solution at 

room temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. The solution 
shall be made as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( Cu S0 4 '5 H 2 ) 4"0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H 2 S0 4 sp gr 184 ) 100 g 
Distilled water [ See IS : 1070-1977 Specification for water 

for general laboratory use (second revision )] 90'0 ml 

No red stains or spots on retractor shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may 
be permitted. 



Adopted 16 September 1981

IS : 9933 - 1981 

6. Marking — Each retractor shall be marked by etching or otherwise with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark and the words 'Stainless Steel'. 

S.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — The retractor shall be wrapped in a moisture-proof paper and packed in a 
polyethylene cover. Alternatively the retractor may be packed as agreed to between the pruchaser 
and the supplier.
